label: Scene Template: Speaker Side-by-Side
description: WHOLE-SCENE template for the speaker BESIDE their content: the film's speaker on camera on one side (live, full-height) and an opaque content panel on the other with the key points or a graphic. Instantiation is deterministic (NO codegen, NO critique): the scene is TRANSPARENT so the speaker-track camera shows on the clear side, and this shell paints the opaque panel over the camera on the content side. Fill the panel with text (headline + body + bullets) OR pass a 'content' component (a stat, chart, mock, or motion graphic) that rides in the panel. Use when the narration is 'the speaker explains X while X appears beside them'.

side.label: Which side the CONTENT panel occupies: right (default -- speaker on the left) | left. Put the panel OPPOSITE the speaker's face.

headline.label: Panel headline -- the point being made.

bullets.label: Array of short strings -- key points with brand-dot markers. Ignored when a 'content' component is supplied. Keep to 2-4.

kicker.label: Optional small eyebrow above the headline.

content.label: Optional paired component to ride in the panel's lower zone instead of bullets: {type: '<library component>', data: {...}} -- e.g. a stat, chart, ui-mock, or motion graphic. Its own schema governs the data.

theme.label: dark (default -- deep brand panel, light type) | light (bright panel, dark type).
